feeds.title: Defence Connect Blog
feeds.description: Defence Connect is a media and market intelligence platform focused on increasing the connectivity of Australia's defence industry and helping the sector capitalise on the largest spend in defence capability building since the Second World War. Defence Connect provides essential business and market intelligence for Australia's defence industry.

feeds.title: Defence Families Of Australia Blog
feeds.description: Defence Families of Australia (DFA) is the official national advocacy and advisory body for Defence families in Australia. Its aim is to improve the quality of life for Defence Families by providing a recognised forum for their views and by reporting, making recommendations and influencing policy that directly affects families in the blog.

feeds.title: Australian Strategic Policy Institute » Australian Army
feeds.description: The Strategist aims to provide fresh ideas on Australia's critical defence and strategic policy choices as well as encourage and facilitate discussion and debate among the strategy community and the Australian public. ASPI is one of the most authoritative and widely quoted contributors to public discussion of strategic policy issues.

feeds.title: Grounded Curiosity Blog
feeds.description: Grounded Curiosity is dedicated to sharing ideas for the profession of arms. This is achieved through debating the future of war and warfare, and junior leaders pitching conceptual ideas to the senior leadership group. The views expressed in the blog are each speaker's alone and do not represent any official position or employer.

feeds.title: Military Books Australia
feeds.description: The blog is intended as a service to Australian readers interested to hear about recently-published military history books and related topics or international readers interested in Australian military history literature. Our regular BOOKS OF INTEREST column appears in Australian Defence Magazine which you can access from the website.

feeds.title: Duty First
feeds.description: Proudly printed quarterly, Duty First is the official magazine of The Royal Australian Regiment Association (RARA). Duty First covers the latest Army, RARA, and ADF news.

feeds.title: Military Life Blog
feeds.description: The military life isn't for everyone and being a military spouse can be hard. Let us help you navigate the military spouse life. The Military Life blog is about telling the stories of Australian Defence Partners. It Connects, informs, acknowledges and supports the Defence Partner Community.

feeds.title: Kinetic Fighting Blog
feeds.description: We specialize in preparing front-line professionals for success in high-end, high-risk operations. We have been setting the standard in close-quarter tactical training for armed forces and organizations operating on the front lines, domestically and internationally. Our elite team, comprised of former Australian Special Forces members and martial arts experts, read more about them and the courses in the blogs.

feeds.title: 3CIR » Military
feeds.description: Provider of Vocational Education & Training, securing the future for our students. Specialising in veterans and emergency services personnel, we help people of all backgrounds gain nationally recognised qualifications.

feeds.title: Contact Magazine
feeds.description: Contact Publishing Pty Ltd is an independent veteran-owned and operated Australian publishing business that curates a daily blog, a fortnightly newsletter, and a quarterly magazine. Browse through the website and find out a lot of content that could interest you.
